# `unsafe-orelse-unreachable`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: strict · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports `orelse unreachable` used to unwrap an optional.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

An absent value becomes a low-context panic rather than an handled case or a
clearly documented invariant.

## When it fires

The strict profile is useful at trust boundaries; proven internal invariants may
instead use an assertion with an explanation.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn first(items: []const u32) u32 {
    return if (items.len > 0) items[0] else 0;
}

fn use(maybe: ?u32) u32 {
    return maybe orelse unreachable;
}
```
